title: SJR 6 (2013 First Regular Session (97th General Assembly)): Allows for photographic identification for voting
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) SJR 6 introduced, new section 8 of article VIII
(quote) Section 8. A person seeking to vote in person in public elections may be required by general law to identify himself or herself and verify his or her qualifications as a citizen of the United States of America and a resident of the state of Missouri by providing election officials with a form of identification, which may include valid government- issued photo identification. Exceptions to the identification requirement may also be provided for by general law.
